name: Eternal Mind (Monster)
body:
Prerequisites(s): Int 21, Iron Will.

Benefit(s): Any creature that attempts to interact directly with your thoughts (such as via detect thoughts or telepathy) must succeed at a Will save or become confused for 1 minute. If you have at least 20 Hit Dice, the target is instead driven permanently insane as the insanity spell (if using the strain rules, you may instead have a target take a number of points of strain damage equal to your Intelligence score on a failed saving throw). The save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + the higher of your Intelligence or Charisma modifier. Using your own telepathy to communicate does not activate this ability unless you spend a standard action to focus your mind on one opponent. A creature targeted by this ability is immune to its effects for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting effect.
